background: BNP Paribas is the largest bank in the eurozone, a universal bank with retail networks in France, Belgium, Italy and Luxembourg, a large corporate and investment bank, and consumer finance, leasing and asset management arms.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the ratings rest on scale and diversification rather than on the ratios. Against EU and Nordic banks every measure is in the bottom quarter: CET1 of 13.0%, leverage of 4.4%, LCR of 135% and NSFR of 109%. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods, so the position is thin but stable. Recent news is good on earnings, and the newest flag, on 8 Oct 2026, is a share price fall.
